answer: A mechanism that actually bites: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because gale only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, signal is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any summit approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
